exclusion_detail: The only starting material, rohitukine, is isolated from plant bark by the authors, not bought (second reader: reject). (Reclassified 2026-10-24 after the verification pass.)

lead.label: K5
lead.why: Abstract: 'The most potent compound K5 was analyzed for antidiabetic and antidyslipidemic activity in vivo.'

reactions.conditions: General method K1-K10: RH stirred in pyridine/triethylamine (6:2) in dry DCM at 40 C for 1 h; sulfonyl chloride added, 4 h; neutralised with 1 N HCl, DCM extraction, silica column. Yield 68% (K5).
reactions.source: Section 2.1 general method, Scheme 1; K5 characterisation Section 3.2.2.5 (page 8)

notes: IMPORTANT: the sole precursor rohitukine (RH) is a natural product isolated by the authors from Dysoxylum binectariferum stem bark (Section 3.2 'Isolation of RH': ethanol percolation, fractionation, silica column, 1.2 g from 1 kg), not purchased. It is not a chemical reaction, so I mark it made_here with no step; a reviewer may prefer to treat rohitukine as the starting material (route = 1 reaction) or drop this paper. Sulfonylation presumably occurs at the secondary 3-OH of the piperidine (K5 name says 'piperidin-3-yl ...sulfonate'). Stereochemistry is not stated in the paper, so none is drawn. The sulfonyl chloride is not explicitly said to be purchased ('required sulphonyl chlorides').
